userDirection: Apply hand-drawn stage background and redraw several existing enemies in user's own style, then test in local game

assets.name: そらとぶスライム
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: one NON-PIXEL hand-drawn enemy creature for a children's fantasy RPG, transparent full-body monster illustration.
Inputs1–4 are the user's OWN original illustrations and PRIMARY STYLE references: rounded expressive storybook animal faces, lively mouths, slightly uneven warm reddish/chocolate-brown pencil outlines, variable line pressure, loose short diagonal hatching for shadows, broad softly brushed flat colored-pencil/pastel fills with restrained interior grain. The user's flyer and wolf comics show how THIS illustrator draws animal characters: broad simple silhouettes, small nose, tall simple oval eyes with small highlights, expressive brows/cheek marks/mouth and a lightly humorous warmth. Build shape and expression from those originals, do not just texture a generic monster.
Input5 is the existing MONSTER DESIGN only. Preserve species, iconic silhouette, color blocks, defining appendages and motifs, but discard original pixel-art grid, black heavy pixel outline, glossy digital gradients and dense tiny detailing. Redraw as natural freehand pencil curves and broad soft color. Creature remains charming and slightly mischievous, recognizable as a game opponent, without frightening horror or gore. Draw exactly ONE creature.
Composition: 1:1 square, entire creature including ears/wings/tail/horns/mushrooms/feet clearly inside canvas with at least8% transparent breathing room. Three-quarter front view, strong readable silhouette and face large enough for game scale. Large expressive pose appropriate to species. Genuine alpha transparency; ALL areas outside silhouette transparent. No scene, paper rectangle, floor, shadow oval, diffuse matte, halo, glossy VFX, frame, text, labels, watermark, extra creatures, human characters or props unrelated to target. Texture stays inside object. No pixel art, block grid, dithering, vector-perfect lines or 3D modeling.
Subject: existing そらとぶスライム. One simple soft turquoise-blue teardrop blob, rounded dome top, two tiny outward soft wing-like nubs on sides, wavy jelly-like base, big simple dark-brown vertical oval eyes with ONE small cream highlight each, cheek marks, lively happy open mouth with coral tongue. Same recognizable blue blob from image5, not a humanized slime girl. Tilt body slightly into a playful forward bounce, one side nub lifted in a cheeky challenge. Paint blue as2–3 broad softly brushed shades with a tiny ivory hand-drawn highlight and some short pencil shadow strokes, not a glossy reflective candy/glass surface. No ambient droplets or floating effects, no ground or shadow.
